answer: Because the prism count is verified against the dawn text itself, the lantern audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 69 aliases thus means producing 69 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
